title: Our Steam store page is now live!
author: Brilliant_Recipe3690
selftext:
[https://store.steampowered.com/app/5477170/Homo\_Forensis/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5477170/Homo_Forensis/)

I've been developing an indie simulation game called Homo Forensis using Unity and ChatGPT.

The game starts with building farms, factories, and shops. Players can expand their production systems, manage businesses, and eventually explore new technologies and environments.

I've been using ChatGPT to help with game design, brainstorming, UI concepts, and preparing my Steam store page.

One challenge I've encountered is keeping the game's visual style consistent while using AI-generated concepts. Sometimes the results look good individually but don't fit together in the actual game.

Today, my Steam store page finally went live!

I'm curious how other developers handle visual consistency when using AI in their development process.
